programs.title: Let The Marriage Be Fruitful
programs.desc: When Delhi boy Mudit Sharma falls in love with Sugandha and proposes to her, he doesn't realize that he has a physical problem that could ruin his marriage. However, with the support of his fiancee, he defies toxic masculinity and societal expectations. Ayushmann Khurrana, Bhumi Pednekar, Seema Bhargava, Anshul Chauhan, Brijendra Kala, Jimmy Shergill, R.S. Prasanna, R.S. Prasanna, Hitesh Kewalya.
